# ADRO.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v2) with a 12-month target of Rp3,002.0 against Rp2,460.0 (expected total return 35.1%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: dividend_income_anchor · method card: per fund record routing for Coal producers.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- Sections 1, 5 and 6 publish "insider ownership is 6889.7% against a free float of 3806.2% [S0]". These are arithmetically impossible (a free float cannot exceed 100%) and the datapack already stores them in percent (mark
- Section 4 states the dividend-yield method runs off "the next twelve months' declared dividend of US$320.3838 per share". The engine's val.dps12 is 320.3838, which is the RUPIAH per-share figure (0.01772 USD x 18,080); t
- The primary method that sets the BUY is a 20-year DCF whose horizon is the template constant params.horizon=20 (assumptions params_basis concedes no reserve/resource statement ties the PKP2B concessions to twenty years),

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
